synthesis.masterPlanMarkdown:
# Master Plan

## Consensus
All six sources agree: build team accounts before billing analytics.

## Conflicts
Sonnet uniquely argues for shipping a thin analytics event schema now so data accrues during the team-accounts build. Recommended resolution: adopt it — it is cheap and removes a future backfill.

## The Plan
1. Build multi-seat team accounts.
2. Land a minimal analytics event schema alongside (no dashboards yet).
3. Build billing analytics on the accrued data next cycle.

## Open questions
- What is the seat model (per-seat vs flat)?
